_help: Campaign offer pages: https://backend.thefither.com/offer/<key>. Edit and save; the page picks changes up within a minute, no restart. offers: package length in MONTHS -> offer price (a number, e.g. 6000) or a percent off the app price (e.g. "25%"). The 'was' price always comes live from the app's Prices table. heroImage: a photo URL or server path (e.g. public/images/hero.jpg) for the top of the page; leave "" to show the next live class instead. goals: the chips under the headline. endsAt: when the timer runs out (Pakistan time). After that the page shows normal prices. planIds: [] = every active plan that has a price for these lengths; or list plan ids to show only those. features: [icon, title, text]; icon is one of class, diet, consult, progress, cycle, community (or any emoji).
